candidates.name: Single-sign cumulative lookup
candidates.sources: Aiyar IX masks; Phaladipika XXIII.20 and BPHS Samudaya 72 support column operation, not cross-edition thresholds
candidates.inputs: Seven recipient counts at one sign
candidates.assumptions: Anchor choice is engineering; no weighting
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Atomic change at ingress of selected anchor; same sign, same result regardless of other transits
candidates.example: USD Aries 43 versus JPY 31: difference 12 marks
candidates.counterexample: All planets occupy different signs: S does not describe all their occupied signs

candidates.name: Equal-weight moving-sign mean
candidates.sources: Aiyar IX unreduced only; universal phala interpretation SOURCE_SILENT
candidates.inputs: Seven simultaneous recipient counts at their own signs
candidates.assumptions: Interchangeable unit of counting, not realized effect; all weights 1/7
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Half-open step; evaluate all new signs before publishing a simultaneous transition
candidates.counterexample: One cell +4 offsets four -1 changes; identities and triggers disappear in sum

candidates.name: Weight envelope and dominance
candidates.formula: P(t)={w dot (B_U-B_J): w>=0, sum w=1}=[min d,max d]
candidates.sources: Same inputs as E; no classical probability for weights
candidates.inputs: Seven paired differences of raw counts
candidates.assumptions: Same unknown nonnegative weights on both sides, unconstrained except simplex; not a confidence interval
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Piecewise extrema; ties may produce flat envelope while components change
candidates.example: Scene [0,2]; any positive weights give a positive difference, boundary weights may tie
candidates.counterexample: Opposing changes yield both signs: no unique ordering
candidates.pairContract: Paired projection only; difference of separately optimized envelopes is incorrect

candidates.name: Source-governed interaction field
candidates.formula: H(c,t,topic)=evaluate applicable source predicates in their own stated order; return set of compatible verdicts
candidates.sources: Phaladipika XXVI.6 obstruction; Sudarsana house rules; Saravali natal conjunctions remain separate profiles
candidates.inputs: Named predicates, target, actor set, house, exceptions, phase and profile
candidates.rangeAndUnits: Categorical: inapplicable, supported, obstructed, mixed, unresolved; no universal amplitude
candidates.assumptions: Only a text-specified priority can resolve a conflict. Simultaneous testimony enters as a set
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Change when any premise changes; exact-time if persistence not proven
candidates.example: Mercury 4 with nonexempt blocker at 3: favorable judgment obstructed
candidates.counterexample: Counting benefic aspects cannot rule out an overriding obstruction; missing blocker data cannot prove absence
candidates.pairContract: Compare named states side by side; subtracting categories undefined

candidates.name: Strength-weighted marks
candidates.sources: Named strength component only; no source bridge to AV
candidates.inputs: Counts and a single commensurate nonnegative strength per planet
candidates.rangeAndUnits: 0..8 weighted marks; pair -8..8 with common k
candidates.assumptions: No negative, missing or all-zero k. Weighting is a hypothesis, not an explicit effect
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Piecewise continuous for continuous k, jumps at AV or strength-rule boundaries
candidates.counterexample: Large strength on a low-mark planet reduces the average; stronger is not necessarily favorable
candidates.pairContract: Only identical weighting policy; disclose any chart-specific weight composition

candidates.name: Geometry-modulated count contrast
candidates.sources: AVG10 geometry + E; attenuation has no classical authority
candidates.assumptions: Concentration, not sign-bearing phase, chosen for nonnegative scaling
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Continuous geometry where evaluated; jumps in E; no interpolation of sampled inputs
candidates.counterexample: Equal antipodal clusters erase nonzero E; attenuation is not evidence of cancellation
candidates.pairContract: Common R1 preserves weak ordering; zero collapses strict ordering

candidates.name: Typed multiscale state with selective projections
candidates.formula: V(c,t)=(B_1..B_7, S_components, motion, geometry, scoped rule states, validity); return pi_topic(V) only when licensed
candidates.sources: Per-coordinate evidence from Aiyar, named Bala profile, astronomy and named contextual rules
candidates.inputs: Counts, virupas, deg/day, dimensionless moments, categories remain separate
candidates.rangeAndUnits: Product space with per-coordinate domains; no universal scalar
candidates.assumptions: No hidden projection or rescaling; keyed identities and evidence stages
candidates.temporalAndConcurrent: Union of proven transition sets, exact-only observations and evaluated continuous coordinates; simultaneous changes atomic
candidates.counterexample: Collapsing this tuple erases domain and unit; one absent source should not blank independent coordinates
candidates.pairContract: Only typed comparable coordinates subtract; category pairs do not

missing: No silent defaults. Required inputs missing => projection unavailable. H uses explicit partial information; V preserves other lanes.
